en-us.Kanade_DiscussAV: Ask her to help with the AV work
en-us.kda_L_brought01:
$kanade.name$ steps forward as if she'd been waiting for this moment.
"I heard everything in that office."
"The filming... let me help with it. That woman said it herself — this face of mine can sell."
"Don't make that face. I'm serious — your debt is my debt too, $self.name$."
en-us.kda_L_left01:
$kanade.name$ is silent for a moment before speaking.
"We agreed you'd take me with you to see her."
"And you went alone anyway. Shielding me behind you even at a time like this — did you think I wouldn't notice?"
When she looks up, it's no longer hurt in her eyes, but resolve.
"So let me help this time. The filming, anything — just stop leaving me out of it."
en-us.kda_L_generic01:
Hearing $self.name$ out, $kanade.name$ grips her skirt and stays silent for a few seconds.
"Filming that... doing those things, in front of a camera."
When she looks up, there's no hesitation left in her eyes.
"But that debt — there's no way you can repay it alone, $self.name$."
"Let me help. Whatever I can offer, I want to offer — this is my family too."
en-us.kda_Q01: "Ask $kanade.name$ to help with the AV work?"
en-us.kda_L_agree:
$kanade.name$ nods and takes a deep breath.
"...All right. It's a promise."
"On set, please don't hold back. Whatever the request — I'll do my best to see it through."
Her face flushes slightly, but she keeps her earnest expression.

[$kanade.name$ has started helping with the AV work (%%ErAV_miyama_Household%%)]
en-us.kda_L_cancel:
"...I see." $kanade.name$ lowers her eyes, then quickly raises them again.
"If you change your mind, come find me anytime."
